title: Xenia record signature sidecar
description: records/<kind>/<id>.sig.json (specs/012 §3): strict JSON with these fixed fields, at most 1 KiB. `hash` is BLAKE3 of the record's raw bytes; `sig` is Ed25519 (RFC 8032 strict) over the store-bound domain string. The verifier builds org, store, kind, id and kid from its own pinned configuration, the path and this file, never from the record.
